[2026-08-28T02:15:58.947Z] [world] Monarch Court — The Cabinet Workshop. An immaculate room of polished tools and dynastic technicians. Tarek serves the Monarchs as their relic-repairer — the older the artifact, the higher up the request came from.

[2026-08-28T02:15:58.948Z] [world] Tarek the Tinkerer sets down what they're holding. "Didn't expect you today, Great Scott."
[2026-08-28T02:15:58.948Z] [world] "Been a while," Tarek the Tinkerer says. "Thought the mud had you."
[2026-08-28T02:15:58.948Z] [world] Tarek the Tinkerer jerks their chin north. "The Mud Monarchs raided our outpost while you were out there. Word travels slower than they do."
[2026-08-28T02:15:58.949Z] [arbiter] Tarek the Tinkerer looks at you sideways. "You still owe us 'Scrap Run'. Say 'turn in scrap run' when you're ready."
